name: Woodblock printing & traditional embroidery
hook: Ink a Đông Hồ print, or stitch in a Hang Trống townhouse — slow craft, not a souvenir stall.
summary: Two bookable crafts. Tân Mỹ embroidery (16 Hàng Trống, ~60–90 min) is a fourth-generation house class: hoop, silk, snacks.
